name: qivvera-foundation
description: Qivvera independent change assurance with verified integrity and operational checks

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p backend/api/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.json && tsc -p frontend/tsconfig.node.json
scripts.build: tsc && tsc -p backend/api/tsconfig.json && vite build --config frontend/vite.config.ts --logLevel warn && node scripts/sync-assets.mjs
scripts.check: node scripts/check-syntax.mjs && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:frontend && node scripts/with-postgres.mjs node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:postgres: node scripts/with-postgres.mjs node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/workflow-postgres.test.mjs test/assurance-postgres.test.mjs test/resolution-postgres.test.mjs test/generalization-postgres.test.mjs test/drafting-postgres.test.mjs test/impact-postgres.test.mjs test/templates-postgres.test.mjs test/operations-postgres.test.mjs test/webhook-postgres.test.mjs test/pr-assurance-postgres.test.mjs
scripts.dev:temporary-db: npm run build && DATABASE_URL= PORT=3100 PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://127.0.0.1:3100 QIVVERA_PR_ASSURANCE_ENABLED=true node scripts/dev.mjs
